retrofit: wm-datacentre DCTCP 'In words' said the window halves 'if every byte was marked' → halves only once marking persists so α approaches 1 (α is a moving average).
retrofit: wm-datacentre renamed the 2014 fabric to 'Meta's' (anachronism) → 'Facebook's (now Meta's)'.
retrofit: wm-cellular bufferbloat worked example defined Δt as 700 ms − 45 ms = 0.65 s → 655 ms, rounded to 0.65 s.
retrofit: wm-wifi AX3000 'In words' ('no single client can use both sums') → a conventional single-link client uses only one radio's rate at a time.
retrofit: glossary band-2-4-ghz 'only three non-overlapping channels in most countries' → about three (1, 6, 11), or four where channels 1–13 are allowed.

retrofit: glossary mathis-model said 'under random loss' → periodic loss (the 1.22 = √(3/2) constant is the periodic-loss model).
